fmea_modes.cause: Pulling ignored active leases, leases omitted original task data, and responses appended without duplicate rejection.
fmea_modes.effect: Concurrency may be exceeded, reclamation may corrupt task identity, and replay may duplicate work.
fmea_modes.controls: Candidate tests constrain remaining capacity, preserved queued-task metadata, and task-ID idempotence across a replay.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Issue a pull lease, reclaim an expired task, and adopt a steal response

ucas.context: An active lease is not counted for a new pull.
ucas.constraint: A pull leases no more than remaining controller capacity.

ucas.context: Reclaim replaces metadata or replay appends transferred tasks again.
ucas.constraint: Leases retain complete queued tasks and local task IDs are adopted at most once.

ucas.context: A response already applied to the receiver is received again.
ucas.constraint: Repeated transferred task IDs do not change the local queue or history.

ucas.context: Expired work remains leased past its deadline.
ucas.constraint: Expired leases leave active state and their original tasks return to pending work.
